rationale: The file contains recognizable HLF transaction entrypoints (Init and Invoke methods). All transaction functions (purchaseTx, checkCustomsTx, exportTx, checkRefunderTx, completeRefundTx, queryByKey) use only deterministic inputs from stub parameters (args array) and stub.GetState() reads. No time-dependent operations (C1), goroutines (C2), map iterations (C3), non-revalidated queries (C4), or mutable global state (C6) influence ledger writes or responses. All PutState calls use deterministic key-value pairs derived from function arguments.
